description: This PHP class file defines the SageMakerGeospatialClient, a client used to interact with Amazon SageMaker's geospatial capabilities service. It includes method annotations for various operations related to geospatial data, jobs, and resources.

classes.name: Aws\SageMakerGeospatial\SageMakerGeospatialClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with AWS SageMaker Geospatial service, extending the base AWS client.
